summary.text: Marygrace Cimino is a Republican state representative from Maine who has represented District 83 since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists her profession as retail management.

paragraphs.text: Marygrace Cimino earned a bachelor's degree from the College of William and Mary in 1990, and her career experience includes working in retail management.
She assumed office in the Maine House of Representatives on December 3, 2024, succeeding Walter Riseman.
